name: agent-brain
description: Persistent cognition store for AI coding agents — v0.10.0 adds `brain revise prepare-from-diff` / `finalize-from-diff` so when staleness flags a captured source as changed, the agent-driven revise helper proposes structured invalidations / reassertions / creations from the diff hunk. Closes the semantic gap between staleness (file changed) and certainty (claim invalidated).
